Hello: Raise open right hand near head/shoulder with palm facing front.
Namaste: Press both flat palms together at center of chest (traditional greeting).
Good: Make a clear thumbs-up gesture in front of your chest.
Bad: Make a clear thumbs-down gesture in front of your chest.
No: Pinch index and middle finger against thumb or wag hand side to side.
Help: Place closed right fist on flat open left palm and lift slightly.
Come: Extend hand with palm facing inward and curl fingers toward you.
Go: Point index fingers forward/away from your body.
Eat: Bring bunched fingertips up to your mouth as if eating.
Drink: Hold curved hand like a cup and tilt it toward your mouth.
Food: Bring fingertips to mouth repeatedly in an eating gesture.
Milk: Open and squeeze your hand twice as if milking.
Book: Place flat palms together with pinky edges touching, then open like a book.
Friend: Interlock index fingers of both hands together.
Family: Form circles with thumbs and index fingers of both hands, joining them.
Father: Tap thumb of open hand against forehead / temple.
Mother: Tap thumb of open hand against side of chin.
Baby: Cradle your arms together and rock them gently side to side.
Doctor: Tap your index and middle fingertips on the inside of opposite wrist (pulse).
Nurse: Touch middle finger to wrist or make cross gesture.
Hospital: Draw a cross on opposite upper arm with index and middle fingers.
Morning: Hold left forearm horizontal, raise right hand upward like rising sun.
Afternoon: Rest right elbow on left hand with right forearm pointing diagonally.
Evening: Rest wrist on left hand with right hand curling downward like setting sun.
Night: Cross right hand downward over left forearm to represent darkness.
Day: Move open arm in an arc across your chest.
Happy: Brush flat open hands upward on chest with a smiling face.
Love: Cross both arms over your chest touching opposite shoulders.
Like: Pinch thumb and middle finger together while pulling away from chest.
Beautiful: Circle open hand around face, then close fingers into a bunch.
Hot: Hold curved hand in front of mouth and blow out or pull away quickly.
Cold: Make two fists and shiver with arms tight against body.
Big: Hold both curved open hands far apart in front of you.
Close: Hold both open hands facing each other and bring them together.
Give: Extend open hands palms up moving forward away from body.
Computer: Mimic typing on a keyboard with both hands.
Car: Grip an imaginary steering wheel with both hands and turn slightly.
Bus: Hold imaginary large bus steering wheel.
Laugh: Place hands near mouth or chest shaking slightly with smiling face.
Name: Tap index and middle fingers of right hand across index and middle of left hand.
Accept: Reach outward with open hands and pull back toward chest closing into fists.
Accident: Bring two fists crashing together in front of chest.
Alone: Hold index finger pointing straight up and circle it slowly.
Answer: Point index finger at lips and then flick it outward toward the viewer.
Apple: Twist knuckle of index finger against your cheek.
Banana: Hold left index finger upright and peel it downward with right hand.
Bread: Slice edge of right hand across back of left wrist/hand.
Cat: Pinch fingers at corners of mouth and pull outward like cat whiskers.
Dog: Pat your thigh or snap fingers.
Door: Hold palms facing outward side by side, then pivot right hand open.
